meta.text: Now compare the two configurations in the HUD. The speed-first build finishes sooner but spends more DBU-hours; the cost-optimized build runs longer yet comes in far cheaper. Your goal is to find the configuration that meets a stated runtime target at the lowest total cost — so try toggling Photon and adjusting spot share to see how each one shifts the total. Now reverse it: set a runtime target, shrink max workers, and hunt for the cheapest setup that still hits it.
